Ana Ribeiro, Marek Nowak, Priya Nair, Tom Ellis
Release 2.4 moves to Friday because the migration will not make it
• The release moves from Wednesday to Friday: the schema migration will not get through staging in
• Agreed not to cut features but to move the date — rolling the migration back costs more than a
• Left open: who is on call over the weekend after the rollout.
• finish the schema migration and run it against staging
• update the changelog and the customer email for the new date
• decide who is on call over the weekend after the rollout
• check that the migration rollback works on a copy of the production database
